plain: To add on top of what is already there

webster.text: To add over and above; to add to what has been added.

example.quote: To superadd a fresh motive to emigration by revoking the liberty which they now enjoy, would be the same species of folly which has dishonoured and depopulated flourishing kingdoms.
example.cite: James Madison, Memorial and Remonstrance Against Religious Assessments, c. June 20, 1785
